value: Historical units of weight, volume, length, and quantity used in Dutch East India Company (VOC) trade records. Based on the Memoriën van Munten, Maaten, en Gewigten (1764-1771), administrative reports documenting local measurement systems across VOC settlements in Asia.
Vellinga, Henrike; Nijman, Brecht; Kuruppath, Manjusha, 2024, 'GLOBALISE - Weights and Measures in the 18th Century Indian Ocean World', IISH Data Collection, V1
